pattern: Structured content: an ordered list of events (day groups as list items with a heading and a nested ordered list); native links and buttons for actions; a horizontal timeline is a focusable, labelled scroll region.

roles.role: listitem with a heading (h2 to h6) and a nested list named by the heading
group named by the item title, containing native buttons

aria.value: true (the tone is also a status word)
older items shown; controls the list
ISO date-time and the full localized date

keyboard.action: Item links and action buttons in order, then 'Show older' or 'Load older'.

focus: After 'Show older' or a successful load, focus moves to the first newly shown item (tabindex=-1, removed on blur); while loading and on error, focus stays on the rebuilt footer button.
notes: Tone is never color only: the marker icon differs per tone and a status word is shown (override it with status).
Loading, results, and errors are announced politely (errors assertively).
Day headings say 'Today', 'Yesterday', a weekday, or a date, and name holidays and non-working days with a business calendar.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
